monsters.name: Adult Red Dragon
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
spells.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
spells.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Light
spells.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
spells.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

items.name: Longsword
items.description: Versatile (1d10). A finely forged double-edged blade.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: A lightweight recurve bow made of seasoned wood.

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather.

items.name: Shield
items.description: A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases Armor Class by 2.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A character who drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 hit points.

items.name: Backpack
items.description: Can hold 1 cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear.

items.name: Rope, Hempen (50 feet)
items.description: Has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A torch burns for 1 hour, providing bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
